scope: Targeted original-book second-pass detection of separately mentioned local/historical/material/household practice details previously compressed under earlier general index labels
methodological_limits: Not full continuous page-by-page completeness certification. OCR text in Scribd cross-referenced to freely accessible original 1958 PDF with selected visually inspected pages, all printed page+OCR line locators. Some actions may be unapproved popular folklore or purely civic. A record is a new source-detail row, not proof of a new unique Catholic custom.
